$comment: Files that still mention `inngest` or `domains/desk` (any case) after `init-app --desk no`, and why each stays. tools/init-app/check-variants.mjs (pnpm verify:scaffold) fails on a hit that is not here and on an entry that no longer matches. `match` is always one of the two bare search strings. The search skips what the rename walker skips (tools/init-app/, docs/superpowers/).
